title: Dispute over debunk of a UAP video (booster vs instrumentation pod)

tellings.quote: Blueg guild triple prime. I think according to Jeffrey Krookshank, who I'm in touch with, um who's analyzed this stuff really deeply, apparently Johnson's actually kind of really scared.

related.note: Same subject: the object seen tumbling out of the Bluegill Triple Prime fireball. Here it is debated as a booster versus an instrumentation pod, not an unidentified craft, so the two accounts could not both be right.

plain: Michels says an attempt to explain away a piece of footage known as Bluegill Triple Prime, in which an object seems to tumble out of a fireball, has been disputed: one side says the object is a rocket booster, the other an instrumentation pod. Michels says he heard from Jeffrey Krookshank, an analyst he is in touch with who has studied the material closely, that a man named Dean Johnson, involved in the debate, is "actually kind of really scared", which Michels takes as a sign the plain explanation may not hold.
